edits.diff:
--- a/package.json
+++ b/package.json
@@ -3,6 +3,13 @@
   "private": true,
   "packageManager": "pnpm@10.0.0",
   "scripts": {
-    "test": "pnpm -r test"
+    "test": "pnpm -r test",
+    "prepare": "hushrun hook install || exit 0"
+  },
+  "hushrun": {
+    "backend": "<your org's URL, once you sign in>"
+  },
+  "devDependencies": {
+    "hushrun": "^<version>"
   }
 }

--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -3,6 +3,9 @@
 jobs:
   test:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      id-token: write
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v5
       - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

notes: your org: connects github.com/acme/shop, so that its CI records results with its own ID token
your org: adds github.com/acme/shop to your org's dashboard, unless it is there already
hushrun.yaml: a new file: repository github.com/acme/shop, its URL on hushrun, and the key that verifies hushrun's log
package.json "test" runs each package's test, which init wraps there, so it skips package by package

One scope for the whole repository: packages/web/package.json gets @acme/core from github:acme/core, which hushrun can't place. Any file's change runs every check; add scopes to hushrun.yaml by hand to narrow that.

scopes.name: default
